invariant: State entity identity is determined by command eligibility and whole-source parser-pass order, not solely by textual order. PSystemCommandFactory.createSystem rewinds the source for each pass returned by StateDiagram.getRequiredPass. Explicit state declarations, composite openings and closings, concurrent separators, and state field or description commands execute in ParserPass.ONE; transitions execute only in ParserPass.TWO. Consequently, every explicitly declared state quark and its enclosing group topology exists before any transition endpoint calls CucaDiagram.quarkInContextSafe(true, name). For an unqualified name, quarkInContextSafe reuses the sole existing quark with that short name; otherwise it creates a child of the active group. Transition-created states within pass two remain source ordered, so a same-named state first introduced by a transition in one ordinary sibling composite can still be reused by a later sibling, while checkConcurrentStateOk keeps concurrent-region children local.
causal_divergence: Rust parses each source line exactly once. In state_composite_transition_into, the top-level transition `Outer --> Inner` executes before the later `state Inner {` declaration and creates a root state with id `Inner`. When the nested declaration is reached, resolve_state_id sees one existing short-name match and reuses that root id while assigning it parent `Outer`; descendants are then qualified as `Inner.S2`. Java's pass one has already created `Outer.Inner` before the transition runs in pass two, so the same transition reuses `Outer.Inner` and descendants are `Outer.Inner.S2`. The SVG geometry is otherwise exact; the divergence is the three qualified names for the nested start, child, and end entities. Changing declaration lookup independently from transition lookup would contradict Java: both CommandCreateState and CommandLinkStateCommon call quarkInContext(true, ...).
planned_change: Add a structural state prepass over the complete source before the existing full parse. The prepass will process only commands that establish state identities or scope topology in Java pass one: explicit state declarations, state descriptions that can create a state, composite close braces, and concurrent separators. It will skip transitions, notes and their bodies, skinparam bodies, and unrelated commands. Reset pass-local scope and concurrent counters before the full parse, retain the predeclared state identities, and clear any prepass-only repeatable payload so descriptions and concurrent-region records are emitted once. Keep the existing sole-short-name reuse and concurrent-region isolation logic unchanged. Verify a renamed root-transition-before-nested-declaration collision, later descriptions that predeclare identity, the existing transition-created sibling reuse behavior, same-name explicit declarations across ordinary siblings, concurrent-region isolation, and controls where no later declaration exists. Do not branch on fixture names, labels, source line numbers, child counts, or rendered coordinates.
